abstract: The frequency of hepatic tissue and its histological characteristics were examined in 516 germ cell tumors. Hepatic tissue was observed in 48 cases (9.3%). The incidence of hepatic tissue was low in tumors of the ovary (5%), high in both retroperitoneal (27%) and sacro-coccygeal (24%) tumors, and low in both mature (0.3%) and immature teratomas (11%). It was usually encountered in infancy, and the frequency was high in both yolk sac tumors (48%) and mixed germ cell tumors (52%). The hepatic tissue found mainly in mature or immature grade 1 teratomas was similar to adult normal human liver tissue (Ha-type). Tissue in areas consisting of some immature somatic elements of a mixed germ cell tumor was similar to embryonic or fetal liver tissue (Hf-type). Many hepatic nests found in a polyembryoma were of both Ha- and Hf-types. The hepatic tissue found in close relation to yolk sac elements showed predominantly hepatocellular carcinoma-like features (HCLS). Immunohistochemically, the cytoplasm of adult liver-type cells was positive for alpha-1-antitrypsin (AAT), human albumin (ALB), and the third (C3) and fourth (C4) components of the complement system. The cytoplasm of fetal liver-type cells showed the same positivity; in addition, these cells were positive for alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) in 25% of the cases. The cytoplasm of hepatic cells of HCLS was positive for AFP, AAT, ALB, C3, and C4. A weakly positive reaction for CEA and CA19-9 was observed in bile duct-like structure in some Hf-type cases.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍516例で肝組織の頻度とその組織学的特徴を検討した。48例(9.3%)で肝組織が認められた。卵巣腫瘍では頻度が低く(5%)、後腹膜(27%)および仙尾部(24%)の腫瘍では高かった。成熟奇形腫(0.3%)および未熟奇形腫(11%)では頻度が低かった。通常は乳児期に認められ、卵黄嚢腫瘍(48%)および混合型胚細胞腫瘍(52%)では頻度が高かった。主に成熟奇形腫または未熟Grade 1奇形腫に認められた肝組織は、成人の正常肝組織(Ha型)に類似していた。混合型胚細胞腫瘍の未熟な体細胞成分の領域の組織は、胚または胎児の肝組織(Hf型)に類似していた。ポリエンブリオーマ内の多数の肝巣は、Ha型とHf型の両方であった。卵黄嚢成分に密接に関連して認められた肝組織は、主に肝細胞癌様の特徴(HCLS)を示した。免疫組織化学的に、成人肝型細胞の細胞質はα1-アンチトリプシン(AAT)、ヒトアルブミン(ALB)、補体の第3(C3)および第4(C4)成分に陽性であった。胎児肝型細胞の細胞質も同様に陽性で、加えて25%の症例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。HCLSの肝細胞の細胞質はAFP、AAT、ALB、C3、C4に陽性であった。CEAおよびCA19-9の弱陽性反応は、一部のHf型症例の胆管様構造で認められた。
